description:
Create a new numbering series for a document type in Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - name (string): Series name (required)
  - format (string): Format string for document numbers (e.g., 'F17%%%%')
  - last (integer): Last number used in the series
  - type (string): Document type (optional, already in path)

Returns:
  The created numbering series.

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

last.description: Last number used in the series

name: holded_invoicing_create_numbering_serie
title: Create Holded Numbering Series
